Name: Slimmer Harvey

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ are required. Download the file then unzip/extract it into into your Stardew mods folder!

I redrew Harvey's sprite to make him look taller and slimmer.
Also added a moustache to him, more in line with the vanilla portrait~
This is my first mod! I hope someone will like it~

If having questions can ask in the post~
